test_title: PYST 58: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘FIND’ is written as ‘CLFB’ and ‘HOW’ is written as ‘VME’. How will ‘WILL’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**‘FIND’ is written as ‘CLFB’,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5aa4240f2d266cb1e4e087d4472d8b5520dae00ab8fceb29bdf3af238774864.png] 

**‘HOW’ is written as ‘VME’,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18b24535ccaeb164530fd488456cf89dc050b8636a0d6dcf817803a9b00a93a3.png] 

Similarly, **‘WILL’ is written as,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68e2274c1fa93aa6ad3fc2b45270965f8b2ce36824daa26f5bb0ba226f50637c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"KJFS".**
